paragraphs: Chapter 977
Episode 241. Rescue (6)
A whirlwind of thunderous energy began to howl around Jin.
Even though the airborne fortresses had raised their altitude to find their positions, their shields were being torn apart by the energy.
It was no problem to continue restoring the shield as they were not operating the main guns, but everyone felt a chill down their spine.
Most of the enemy tribes would not be able to withstand a few seconds in that golden hell.
Just swinging a sword would be out of the question; they would be engulfed in a sensation of burning all over, and in an instant, they would be at death's door.
Facing this, Luke also amplified the energy of his Thunder God Sword and displayed another divine skill.
Around Luke, ten swords formed from lightning rose up, pushing back the encroaching golden lightning.
However, they could not repel Jin, who had already closed the distance. Sigumund was already falling toward Luke's head.
The clash was not of sword against sword, but mountain against mountain, resulting in an earthquake and a loud thunderous roar.
The retreating ground could not withstand their power, sinking instantly, but with each collapse, the two masters created solid ground with their energy to maintain their stance.
"Yes, successor of the current divine warrior. I've always been curious about you, Jin Runcandel. Today I see your power firsthand."
Luke's sword was slow.
As soon as he engaged Jin in combat, Jin felt that. His sword was slow and dull.
But it was unavoidable.
Like the blunt sword shown by Chiron in the past, Luke's sword had a characteristic that transcended the opponent's sense and perception itself.
However, the one who realized this mysterious sword was also Jin.
Furthermore, the golden domain of the Sovereign Ruling Sword was Jin's territory. He floated like a ghost through the lightning, incessantly thrusting his sword at Luke.
Always, Jin was attacking from above, and Luke was defending from below. The interaction continued in this manner.
Luke's dull sword seemed to slice through time itself.
Every time he raised his sword, the trajectory warped space oddly, and within that divided space, even the speed of the Sovereign Ruling Sword's lightning changed.

In this way, Luke continued to destroy the space Jin was trying to enter, and each time, Jin cut through that space again, restoring the damaged part of the Sovereign Ruling Sword to its original state.
A battle between masters.
For those dwelling beneath the masters, it was a scene they could not even dare to mimic.
The chaotically erupting swords threatened each other's lives every moment.
"You're mistaken."
Squeak-!
It was Jin who drew the opponent's blood first.
Sigmund's pale blade grazed Luke's cheek. However, almost simultaneously, Luke also left a scratch under Jin's eye.
"I'm here to administer punishment, not to waste time deciding who's superior between us."
Jin ducked, dodging Luke's horizontal swipe.
In the lowered position, his strike missed Luke and headed towards the pit.
Luke didn't forget about the pit for a moment while facing Jin.
As if he had anticipated it, he quickly sent two swords back to block Jin's sword energy that was heading toward the shield.
However, facing a fellow master like Jin and also paying attention to the shield soon proved to be Luke's limit.
Creak-! Rumble......!
'...A meteor shower!'
Once again, a meteor shower was striking the shield that covered the pit.
Luna, she was currently supporting Jin from the rear of the battlefield. She had placed the unconscious Eltiot beside her.
If he were in Luke's position, Jin would have lost sight of Luna for a moment as well.
In a close-quarters battle between two masters, it was inevitable.
"Since becoming a knight, it's my first time only providing long-range support. Not bad at all. Right, Eltiot? For some reason, I like you."
Eltiot responded with a groan.
The enemy tribes' airborne fortresses and fleets were also concentrating their fire on the pit.
Looking at the two masters fighting, it was clear that unless they operated the main guns to the maximum, any other support would be meaningless.
But using the main guns like that would also sweep Jin away, turning the battle once again into a three-way conflict. So, for the enemy tribes, targeting the shield was the best choice.
For Luna, she could comfortably unleash a meteor shower. Nothing threatened her at that moment.
Sigmund tore Luke's backhand.
The thought that the shield was in danger created an extremely faint ripple in his inner mind, and Jin didn't miss that opportunity.
However, he could not inflict more than a shallow cut on the back of Luke's hand.
And then Jin began to open the Sovereign Ruling Sword once more.
Following Jin's will, a golden tidal wave surged in all directions.
The tidal wave repeatedly fell and rose, swarming around Luke like a whirlpool that circled in place.
Luke did not avoid the tidal wave.
Every time the Thunder God's sword flashed, the tidal wave scattered and momentarily opened a path, and Luke instead charged at Jin.
Luke's ten floating swords were shot through the gaps where the tidal wave was cut.
Two of them grazed Jin's forehead and side.
"Suddenly, I find myself missing the duel of the gods."
"How unfortunate. Not even a breeze from Lafrarosa would miss you. A former duel-god, wallowing in a cult."
Luke didn't answer, instead pushing Jin away with all his might.
Both of them knew very well that they could not kill each other today. The victory or defeat would be decided by what happened to those inside the shield.
Luke's shield was still unbroken.
However, the shield did not absorb all the shock transmitted to the interior.
"Cough, gasp...!"
Airan was on his knees, seemingly crushed, spitting out a clump of blood.
Bang, bang! His body felt like it would burst every time the shield vibrated.
'Is Bivol... dead?'
They all thought they would survive together when the Solar Church suddenly appeared, but Bivol had no reaction, even when his body was flung by the shockwave, his eyes open.
Moreover, Temar Vermont's condition was strange.
"Argh, ahhhhhh...!"
He banged his head on the ground.
It was because the memories left in Temar's left arm were confusing him.
"Temar Vermont, pull yourself together...!"
"Lu, Runcandel... Runcandel's... sword, why is it targeting me?"
Unrecognizable rune characters were surfacing on Temar's left arm.
Luna's energy had stimulated that left arm.
When the rune characters began to shine, the remaining red energies in Temar Vermont started to disappear.
"Temar Vermont, can you recover? Protect me, just hold on a little longer, Eiza will open the dimension gate."
However, the next moment, Temar suddenly stood up and plunged a broken sword into Sanna's back.
"Te, Temar!?"
After obtaining Temar's left arm, there was one fact that the royal family had not known until now.
In that left arm, not only some of Temar's memories remained, but also a part of his will.
"Cough...!"
The dimensional gate was just about to open.
Even for Luke, this time he couldn't help but be completely focused on the shield.
Time was almost up, and an accident had occurred in the pit, where the shield had not yet been penetrated.
He won't die easily.
What Sanna said was clearly true.
She felt pain like ordinary people and had a fragile body, but without a "special power," she could never be killed.
But coincidentally, Temar's left arm had that power. The will of a knight who ascended a thousand years ago.
"Th-this can't be."
"Maiden!"
In the end, Luke showed his back to Jin.
And that meant he couldn't escape unscathed.
Jin charged at him, intending to cut him in two, and struck down with his sword.
The clear sensation of tearing flesh and reaching bone, Jin even detonated the electric shock before the blade passed through that sensation.
The electric shock exploded inside his back, and Luke's waist bent forward.
If he had been human when he ascended, rather than a member of the Demon King's tribe, he would not have escaped death.
Luke continued towards the pit, forcibly holding together his splitting spine using the electric shock.
It wasn't that Jin's attack had landed shallowly. Luke had simply withstood the blow in a way Jin hadn't anticipated.
Jin fired his sword's energy again, but Luke had already erased the shield and entered the pit.
His torn and exploded back was dangling with flesh and pieces of bone.
"I'm sorry, I failed to keep my promise, Maiden."
The variable of Temar's left arm had come into play, but it was never Luke's fault.
However, Luke did not think so.
It was his mistake for not being able to turn the situation as favorably as Jin, even with the power to transcend fate.
Then Luke grabbed Temar Vermont's head with his left hand.
Temar Vermont momentarily convulsed from the electric shock spreading from Luke's palm, then passed out.
"Ugh, you didn't kill him, did you?"
"I held back."
With his right hand, he held Ailan.
Unable to withstand the energy radiating from Luke's wild heart, Ailan lost consciousness.
"10 seconds. If you can't open the dimensional gate in that time, it's over."
Meteor showers and bombardments were falling again.
But those attacks were fine.
Compared to when Jin would enter the pit and swing his sword shortly after, it was nothing.
7 seconds, Luna and the enemy tribe stopped supporting, allowing Jin to enter the pit.
6 seconds, Jin descended into the pit, leading the entire thunderbolt of the Demon King's Dominating Sword.
Luke had no strength to swing his sword as he was protecting the three people.
All Luke could do was to detonate all the remaining thunderbolts in his wild heart to delay Jin's approach.
Jin didn't know exactly how much time they had left.
However, he knew the end was near, and he was sure that he could kill them in a few seconds if Luke didn't abandon the three and grab a sword himself.
So, concentrating the Demon King's Dominating Sword's thunderbolt at one point to slaughter them all, the moment came.
Temar's left arm appeared.
The left arm of the original patriarch, faintly glowing with rune characters, was left too defenseless.
Swinging such immense power would surely damage that arm.
Zzzzzz-!
While contemplating how not to damage the arm, the dimensional gate opened.
"Today, the victory is yours, Jin Runcandel."
Luke's last words as he disappeared into the dimensional gate.
It signified not the result of the battle but a contest among the same Demon King's tribe.
Luke had failed to keep his promise to Sanna and therefore suffered a mortal wound.
As the dimensional gate closed, Jin recalled the last appearance of Temar Vermont, even the broken sword stuck in Sanna's back.
"We retreat now, withdraw at full speed."
"We will open the dimensional gate once safety is secured!"
Bakarun and Shimat quickly issued orders as soon as they confirmed the fight was over.
Getting involved with Jin and his siblings even a bit more now was a horrifying thought, even in imagination.
